title: Supplier Strategy — Turning TQRDC Scores into Order Allocation
summary: Compared suppliers for cables, printed wiring boards and sheet metal using a TQRDC-style assessment, SWOT and industry analysis.
context: The sourcing team needed a consistent way to judge when to maintain or change the order share of existing suppliers across categories.
decisions: I reviewed suppliers across technology, quality, responsiveness, delivery and cost. I used SWOT and industry analysis to separate supplier-specific performance from market constraints, then considered where qualification or a limited set of alternatives constrained the allocation decision.
outcome: The strategy deck documented proposed order shares by category and the rationale for maintaining or changing allocations.
